summary: Boyd Gaming Corporation filed a Form 8-K under Item 8.01, disclosing that its Board of Directors declared a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.20 per share, payable July 15, 2026 to shareholders of record on June 15, 2026. This is a routine capital allocation action rather than a special situation. The filing contains no acquisition, divestiture, activist activity, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, spin-off, restructuring, or other event-driven corporate action. It is an ordinary event not requiring reclassification beyond standard dividend disclosure.
